info.brief: The light sources manager. It keeps the list of point light sources and the camera
info.description:
The light sources manager. It keeps the list of point light sources and the camera
position, and each frame writes the sorted sources and the camera values into
`light_and_shadows.constants`. `light_setting.script` calls `set_color` and `update`,
and a scene controller calls `set_position` as its camera moves. Assigning a new value
to a field goes through a cast, since a namespace import is read-only.

elements.name: list
elements.brief: Every point light source, keyed by its game object id. `update` reads it every frame.
elements.description: Every point light source, keyed by its game object id. `update` reads it every frame.

elements.name: cam_look_at
elements.brief: The point the camera looks at, set by `set_position`. Light sources are sorted by their distance from it.
elements.description: The point the camera looks at, set by `set_position`. Light sources are sorted by their distance from it.

elements.name: cam_position
elements.brief: The camera world position, set by `set_position`.
elements.description: The camera world position, set by `set_position`.

elements.name: cam_view
elements.brief: The camera rotation, set by `set_position`. A source with `rotate` set turns to it.
elements.description: The camera rotation, set by `set_position`. A source with `rotate` set turns to it.

elements.name: top_v
elements.brief: The up vector, rotated by a game object's world rotation to give a spotlight's direction.
elements.description: The up vector, rotated by a game object's world rotation to give a spotlight's direction.

elements.name: cam_z
elements.brief: The camera Z coordinate, the distance from the focus point that depth of field needs. Set it here or with `set_position`'s `cam_z`.
elements.description: The camera Z coordinate, the distance from the focus point that depth of field needs. Set it here or with `set_position`'s `cam_z`.

elements.name: attenuation_coefficient
elements.brief: Divides a source's squared distance from the camera focus point before it scales the source's power.
elements.description: Divides a source's squared distance from the camera focus point before it scales the source's power.

elements.name: set_color
elements.brief: Sets the base light uniform constants in `light_and_shadows.constants`. An omitted
elements.description:
Sets the base light uniform constants in `light_and_shadows.constants`. An omitted
value leaves its constant as it is. It also posts `clear_color` to `@render:` with
`clear_color`, or `fog_color` when that is omitted.

parameters.name: fog_color
parameters.doc: The fog color in RGB; `w` is the fog density.

parameters.name: fog
parameters.doc: The minimum and maximum Z in camera view space where the fog begins and ends.

parameters.name: clear_color
parameters.doc: The color that clears the default render target, which is the background color.

elements.name: set_position
elements.brief: Sets the camera rotation, the point the camera looks at, and the camera position.
elements.description: Sets the camera rotation, the point the camera looks at, and the camera position.

parameters.name: cam_look_at_position
parameters.doc: The point the camera looks at.

parameters.name: cam_z
parameters.doc: The camera Z coordinate, the distance from the focus point, for depth of field. Omitted, `cam_z` keeps its value.

elements.name: reset
elements.brief: Clears the light sources sent to the shader and restores the module's default
elements.description:
Clears the light sources sent to the shader and restores the module's default
ambient, fog color and fog constants.

elements.name: update
elements.brief: Prepares the constants for the render script: updates each source's position and
elements.description:
Prepares the constants for the render script: updates each source's position and
spotlight direction from its game object, sorts the sources by distance from the
point the camera looks at into `light_and_shadows.constants.lights`, attenuates
their power, and copies the camera values. Call it from `update`.

properties.name: value
properties.brief: The color in `x`, `y`, `z`. `w` is the power `update` attenuates by distance; `bulb.script` sets it to `1 / power`.
properties.description: The color in `x`, `y`, `z`. `w` is the power `update` attenuates by distance; `bulb.script` sets it to `1 / power`.

properties.name: current_value
properties.brief: The color sent to the shader, its `w` attenuated by distance. `update` creates it from nothing when it is absent.
properties.description: The color sent to the shader, its `w` attenuated by distance. `update` creates it from nothing when it is absent.

properties.name: position
properties.brief: The world position. `w` carries the spotlight smoothness, from `0` (soft) to `1` (hard).
properties.description: The world position. `w` carries the spotlight smoothness, from `0` (soft) to `1` (hard).

properties.name: direction
properties.brief: The spotlight direction. `w` is the cone angle in radians; `0` or less turns the spotlight off.
properties.description: The spotlight direction. `w` is the cone angle in radians; `0` or less turns the spotlight off.

properties.name: num
properties.brief: A positive number keeps the source out of the distance sort and always visible; the default is `-1`.
properties.description: A positive number keeps the source out of the distance sort and always visible; the default is `-1`.

properties.name: static
properties.brief: When `true`, `update` never reads the game object's world position again.
properties.description: When `true`, `update` never reads the game object's world position again.

properties.name: static_spot
properties.brief: When `true`, `update` never reads the game object's rotation for the spotlight direction again.
properties.description: When `true`, `update` never reads the game object's rotation for the spotlight direction again.

properties.name: rotate
properties.brief: When `true`, `update` rotates the game object to the camera rotation, as a billboard.
properties.description: When `true`, `update` rotates the game object to the camera rotation, as a billboard.

properties.name: y_offset
properties.brief: Added to the world Y position each frame.
properties.description: Added to the world Y position each frame.

properties.name: id
properties.brief: The game object id, as `bulb.script` stores it.
properties.description: The game object id, as `bulb.script` stores it.

properties.name: timer
properties.brief: A timer `bulb.script` stores; `update` does not read it.
properties.description: A timer `bulb.script` stores; `update` does not read it.
